summary.text: Chris Kannady represents District 91 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives. A University of Oklahoma graduate and former Marine, he is a Colonel and State Staff Judge Advocate for Air in the Oklahoma National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Kannady graduated from the University of Oklahoma with undergraduate, law and MBA degrees, and served as student body president there.
While serving in the Marines he earned a master's degree from George Washington University in national security and foreign relations.
His House biography says he served as a prosecutor in Iraq handling detainee operations and was deployed three times to Afghanistan and once to Iraq.
After a knee injury in Afghanistan he left the Marines and continued his service in the Oklahoma National Guard.
The page says he continues to help fellow veterans at Foshee and Yaffe, and that he and his wife, Renee, are raising two children.
